user.title: Aquecimento Ninjas
user.description: Per-room heating with Better Thermostat (required). Up to 5 radiator valves in total.

data_description.boiler_mode: Use a thermostat you already have (e.g. generic_thermostat) or let the integration create one.

boiler.title: Boiler
boiler.description: Choose how the boiler is controlled.

data_description.boiler_climate: Climate entity that fires the boiler. Set its target sensor to the 'Reference temperature' sensor of this integration.
data_description.boiler_switch: Switch that turns the boiler on. Optional for an existing thermostat (used for the statistics).
data_description.cold_tolerance: Boiler turns on when the reference temperature is this much below the target.
data_description.hot_tolerance: Boiler turns off when the reference temperature is this much above the target.
data_description.min_cycle: Minimum time the boiler stays on or off. 5 minutes is recommended.

room.title: Room {room_number}
room.description: Valves used: {valves_used} of {valves_max}. A room with two radiators uses one Better Thermostat with both valves.

data_description.climate: Create it first in Better Thermostat with the same valves and room sensor.
data_description.valves: The valves controlled by that Better Thermostat (counted for the 5-valve limit).
data_description.batteries: Optional. Used for the dashboard and low-battery notifications.
data_description.windows: Optional. Used for the dashboard and open-window notifications.

data_description.persons: Optional. When everyone is away for the delay, away mode turns on; it turns off when someone arrives.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Creates a dashboard with the views Heating and Charts.
